title: Frequent-Payout Pricing of the Fixed Transfer Fee on Payout Methods
content:
The fixed part of the transfer fee on a Payout Methods transfer is a share of the rail's fixed fee, set by how often the method is paid and by who holds the account: 60 percent when the method received at least 8 transfers less than 6 whole months before the booking day and the host account carries a registered business name, 80 percent when it received at least 8 such transfers and the host account carries no business name, and the full fixed fee otherwise.

## Inputs

- **Transfers received.** Transfers sent to this method on dates less than 6 whole months before the booking day, the day the transfer fee is booked on the method's ledger. A transfer sent exactly 6 whole months before that day is outside the window.
- **Business name.** The registered business name on the host's Host Accounts record. An individual host's record carries none.

## Truth table

| Transfers to the method in the window | Business name on the host account | Fixed part of the transfer fee |
|---|---|---|
| 8 or more | Registered | 60 percent of the rail's fixed fee |
| 8 or more | None | 80 percent of the rail's fixed fee |
| 7 or fewer | Registered | The full fixed fee |
| 7 or fewer | None | The full fixed fee |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- An imagined property-management business with a registered business name has an International Wire Transfer method that received 9 transfers in the window. The rail's fixed fee is USD 15.00; the fixed part is 60 percent of it, USD 9.00.
- An imagined individual host with no business name has a Western Union Cash Pickup method that received 8 transfers in the window. The rail's fixed fee is USD 4.00; the fixed part is 80 percent of it, USD 3.20.
- The same individual host with only 7 transfers in the window: the fixed part is the full USD 4.00.
- With an imagined booking day of 2026-07-20, a transfer sent on 2026-01-20 is 6 whole months earlier and is not counted; one sent on 2026-01-21 is 5 whole months earlier and is counted.

## Note

The share applies to the fixed part only. On a rail whose fixed fee is USD 0.00, every share of it is USD 0.00.
